note: The interface is now known. What is still missing is an authenticated path onto the robot (SSH) to publish the topic, and a supervised first test. Do not set enabled=true until robot-bridge/arm_bridge.py has been reviewed and run with --print-only first.

source.section: 7.1.9 Arm Control Command and Status Topic Interfaces

state.notes: 14 joints. Joints 6 and 7 of each arm are a coupled parallel mechanism: position only, no valid velocity/effort.

rate.smoothing: vendor recommends at least a first-order low-pass: y = (1-a)*y_prev + a*x

actionGate.consequence: McAction_DEFAULT is NOT permitted. Arm commands published in DEFAULT are outside the documented contract and must be treated as unsupported.

switchInterface.notes: Asynchronous. Poll GetAction until the switch completes before publishing.

knownBlocker.motionPlayer: In JOINT_SERVO mode /motion/control/arm_joint_command is taken over by the motion_player module. The vendor requires examples/motion_player/disable_motion_player.sh to be run first. This is a robot-side change and needs explicit approval.
knownBlocker.presetPlayback: Disabling motion_player may stop factory preset gestures. Confirm with the operator before doing it.

limits.docTypo: idx26 is printed as '0.35 ~ 0.35'; treated as the mirrored +-0.35 of idx19.

recommendedEnvelope.note: vendor 'yellow region' for the parallel wrist — narrower than the kinematic limit
